name: SAREF
notes: ETSI TS 104 267 is an adopted work item for a SAREF SHACL Shapes Repository. The repository is not yet published as of 2026-09-28.

name: QUDT
description: QUDT ontologies and SHACL schema graphs
notes: Official QUDT catalog publishes versioned SHACL and OWL schema graphs. Version 3.5.2 was current when screened.

name: OGC Building Blocks
description: Reusable OGC specification components with SHACL validation resources
notes: Public OGC register provides SHACL shapes, tests, validation reports, and versioned building block metadata. Screened against repository commit af182cbb1a49775a3ecd526bed20a2600ab3e639.

name: GeoSPARQL
description: GeoSPARQL standard and its SHACL validation resources
notes: GeoSPARQL 1.1 includes an official SHACL RDF validator. OGC also maintains a separate repository of community contributed extended GeoSPARQL shapes.

name: DCAT-AP
description: DCAT application profile and its SHACL validation resources
notes: The official repository contains versioned DCAT-AP releases with SHACL constraint files. Version 3.0.1 was the current recommendation when screened.

name: ODCT
description: SHACL constraints and validation resources for SAREF and SAREF4ENER
notes: Public Zenodo record provides the SHACL shapes, datasets, documentation, and validation reports used in the ODCT study.
